input_bytes: The original ggml_quantize_chunk encoded two rows with exact source values ((17*i+5) mod 51 - 25)/16 and uniform importance when required. The F32 addend is ((13*i+7) mod 29 - 14)/32. Row width is the least common multiple of source and destination block sizes.
oracle: Original CPU ggml_add_cast, ggml_add, ggml_add_inplace with one worker. Source has a compiled packed-add branch and decoder, destination has a from_float CPU callback. Equal-storage standard, cast and in-place graphs were independently executed and returned the same bytes.
build: The unmodified pinned CPU was compiled by the repository conformance recipe with GGML_CPU_GENERIC, -ffp-contract=off and one worker.
